deepDecisions.why: its channel-non-substitutable design and explicit transition/evidence accounting directly expose a Ferrum observability gap, but its agent-as-judge and VM stack are too heavy/nondeterministic to become Ferrum authority
fresh-context executor plus independent auditor matches Ferrum durability goals, but Ferrum already owns execution/evidence contracts and should not replace them with a second orchestrator

acceptanceGate: exact PR head passes all triggered workflows including severe Ferrum CI
existing workload pack smoke still executes real child specs with full child evidence
unit coverage proves target counts, step counts, timing, evidence counts and adjacent target transitions without caps
compact result exposes metrics while preserving member evidence references
no existing target, browser, evidence, package, MCP or runtime coverage is weakened

challengePass.reason: a true channel-non-substitutable hybrid task pack requires a purpose-built shared-state fixture and real-runtime proof; fabricating one during the metrics patch would conflate observability with benchmark validity

nextExperiments: After PR70 converges, create one Ferrum-owned task whose passing final state genuinely requires both browser/GUI evidence and process/API evidence, then measure task success, target transitions, elapsed time and evidence completeness.

Create a small MCP beneficial-vs-distractor benchmark inspired by OSWorld-MCP and record correct tool-selection ratio plus unnecessary calls.

raw parent and child evidence remains authoritative
